rows.category: ordinary Corrupted and other active tagged corruption
rows.established: Cleanse/Purge provide examples of ending actual eligible active records. Ordinary unprotected Corrupted is a supported removable example, and Purge covers eligible major nonintrinsic applications too.
rows.remaining: Bind Purification-specific all-record operation/protection handling and actual useful recipient state; do not restrict rank9 to lower Cleanse minor/one-effect scope.

rows.category: numeric corruption / Unity Exposure / other numeric exposure
rows.established: A numeric track is not automatically an active removable effect. Lower exclusions do not by themselves define rank9 scope.
rows.remaining: Exact track IDs, authorized cure operation, amount/result, dependencies and preserved history; no guessed reset or few-point substitute.

rows.established: KT is a distinct knowledge ledger; actual knowledge acquisition remains. Incoming KT3 resistance classification is not cure authority.
rows.remaining: Any explicitly authorized Purification interaction with current KT/symptoms while retaining actual knowledge, memory and history; no automatic stage deletion.

rows.category: PT current exposure stage and history
rows.established: PT is distinct from KT/ordinary Corrupted; source-defined rest/recovery and symptoms have their own endpoints. Incoming Corruption Ward advantage does not extend to PT recovery.
rows.remaining: Exact cure operation for current stage and actual symptoms without erasing prior exposure history or fabricating a recovery/cure save.

rows.established: Symptoms, knowledge and generators are separate. Ending a symptom does not prove its parent ended; source-specific time endpoints remain relevant.
rows.remaining: Snapshot actual captured dependencies, once-only callbacks, outside parent survival and terminal state; no expanded target set or duplicate removal.

rows.category: intrinsic/class records and specially protected effects
rows.established: Oracle Curse/Burden is not a generic condition, and explicit source protections are not defeated by rank alone. Lower spell exclusions are not a universal rank9 cure matrix.
rows.remaining: State each applicable source protection and any actual Purification authorization/exception, without blanket bypass or reclassification.

rows.category: completed anatomy, HP/Wounds, dead/alive, knowledge, history and real inventory
rows.established: Corruption removal does not automatically heal, resurrect, reconstruct anatomy or erase history. A removed actual active source can have its own scoped teardown.
rows.remaining: Bind those exact callbacks and retained physical/custody states in positive witnesses.

rows.established: Only current Mask confession, actual Archon Temporary Blessing granting and consumed Bittersap Antidote purge Veil. Ordinary exit and this Purification review supply no fourth route.
rows.remaining: No new purge permission is open here. Preserve Veil/exposure/history in cure witnesses; separately eligible corruption on the same bearer remains separate.
